reason: No authorized Kickstart image is available: none is committed (commercial ROMs are never downloaded or stored here) and P6_KICKSTART_ROM is not set in this environment.

firmware.identity: by CRC32/SHA-1 of the decoded image (manifests/config-invariants.json); the digest is recorded here when the owner of a legal copy supplies one

what_it_will_check: p6_load accepts the image (checksum, size, header)
300 video units run without the CPU halting or the instance faulting
video is delivered every unit and the picture is not a single colour
two runs with the same seed produce identical unit reports
unproven_until_it_runs: Kickstart 1.2/1.3 boot to the insert-disk screen: shown once locally with a 1.3 image (local_run), not reproducible from the repository
the initial LOF state and whether the ROM leaves the long-field bit set (576-row episodes): measured once with a 1.3 image (local_run)
the display window and overscan the ROM uses inside the 756x574 raster: not measured
PAL/NTSC detection by the ROM, and the CIA/keyboard/floppy paths it exercises before the boot screen: not exercised
any compatibility of the micro-ROM results with a real ROM, including timings of DMA-heavy code: not extrapolated

local_run.image: Kickstart v1.3 r34.5, 262144 bytes, supplied by the owner outside the repository; neither the image nor its hash is recorded here
local_run.result: 300 units ran without halting or faulting; every unit delivered a picture; the picture reaches the insert-disk screen (hand holding a disk labelled Workbench V1.3) and shows 6 distinct colours at unit 300; two runs with the same seed gave identical reports
measured: active raster 756x574 in the first units and 756x576 from some unit before 298: this ROM leaves the long-field bit set
the PAL cadence reported at unit 1 is 3546895/70824 and at unit 298 is 3546895/71051 (the boot changes the frame length)
local_run.not_covered: one image, one seed, PAL, no disk inserted: nothing here claims Kickstart compatibility or a deterministic reload with a real ROM
